Name: HCW Function Settings Reader
Description: List app settings on sites in rg-web-site-prod-cus. The one thing the read-only monitor needs that the Reader role cannot express: listing app settings is Microsoft.Web/sites/config/list/action, an action rather than a read, so */read does not cover it. Consumed by infra/oidc.tf for monitor-functions-registered.yml; created once by the owner because the Terraform identity deliberately lacks Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/write.
